entry.title: Ju-08 1.1.0
entry.summary: **100 new performances** that use both parts at once. The new programs P01–P100 come after the 64 patches (11–88). Each one sets: - **Both patches:** the Upper patch with the effects, and the Lower patch. - **The key mode:** Dual, with both patches on every key, or Split, with the Lower patch below C3, G3 or C4. - **The performance settings:** part levels, arpeggio, portamento and mod-wheel routing.
